content.short: Taraxa is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain using a blockDAG architecture and t-Graph consensus.
content.description: Taraxa is an EVM-native smart contract platform that uses a blockDAG architecture to boost scalability, security, and decentralization. By combining a blockDAG topology with a Proof-of-Stake consensus, Taraxa enables high transaction throughput and true finality without compromising network security or decentralization. This design supports efficient execution of smart contracts and on-chain applications, delivering robust performance for developers and users alike.
